about: Briars and thorns, from docs/ideation-track-2/tribes/thorn/units.json (19 units and the Pip token). Ideation track 2; nothing here is decided. Numbers are {param} placeholders filled from the effects (golden doubles them, 7.3.5); golden_text is the golden copy's text where it is not a plain doubling. 'reminders' are 'Name: reminder' lines for every term the card's text uses, copied from SHARED-RULES; a number a golden doubles is written N there (the card's pill gives the number).
